question: State whether the following statements are True or False: (b) The provisions of leave rules shall apply to persons re-employed after retirement as if he had entered Government service for the first time on the date of his re-employment.
State whether the following statements are True or False: (a) Earned leave should not ordinarily be denied to any Government servant especially in the last ten years of his career.
State whether the following statements are True or False: (c) A Government servant on extraordinary leave is not entitled to any leave salary.

State whether the following statements are True or False: (d) Special disability leave is admissible to all Government employees (permanent or temporary) who are disabled by any injury or illness incurred in the performance of his duty.

State whether the following statements are True or False: (e) If the operation of any of these rules causes undue hardship in any particular case, any of the provision of these rules can be relaxed by the Ministry of Finance.
